newsitem.title: USA: Fulton Financial buys Woodstown Nat'l.
newsitem.headline: Fulton Financial buys Woodstown Nat'l.

text.p: Fulton Financial Corp said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy Woodstown National Bank & Trust Co in stock transaction estimated at $57.6 million.

The companies said each share of Woodstown National's common outstanding will be exchanged for 1.6 shares of Fulton Financial, with a dollar value of $20 per share, based on Friday's closing. The price is about 2.37 times Woodstown National's September 30 estimated value of $13.52 per share and 15.56 times its projected 1996 earnings of $3.7 million, the companies said.
Woodstown National said it has 1.8 million shares of common stock outstanding.
The acquisition is expected to close by end of the 1997 first quarter and needs approval from Woodstown National shareholders, both companies said.

Fulton said it would have about $4 billion in assets after the acquisition. The Lancaster-based bankholding company said it would also have 118 banking offices in Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland and New Jersey through 10 subsidiaries.
